summary: Iteration 16 - Full verification of the 3 new features on Kitab Cloud Reading Streak. BACKEND (pytest 12/12 passing @ /app/backend/tests/test_reading_streak_features.py): (a) GET /api/reading-streak now returns reading_goal_days, reading_goal_pages, reading_goal_minutes, pages_today, minutes_today; (b) PUT /api/reading-streak/goal accepts goal_days / goal_pages / goal_minutes as independent query params (single or multi), persists via GET, validates ranges (days 1-7, pages 1-500, minutes 5-480), 400 for out-of-range, 400 when no params; (c) POST /api/reading-session properly increments pages_today / minutes_today counters. FRONTEND (Playwright verified on preview URL): (1) LibraryPage compact widget rendered as <a href='/reading-streak' data-testid='compact-streak-dashboard'>; click navigates to /reading-streak — PASS. (2) /reading-streak Overview tab shows 'Today's Progress' section with 'Pages 7/20' and 'Time 11/30m' progress bars — PASS. (3) Goals tab shows all THREE goal cards: 'Days Per Week', 'Daily Pages Goal', 'Daily Reading Time' — PASS. (4) Editing Pages goal to 30 → clicked Save → UI updates to '30 pages' + persisted — PASS. (5) Editing Minutes goal to 45m → clicked Save → UI updates to '45 min' + persisted — PASS. (6) Defaults restored (20 pages, 30 min) at end of test. Desktop nav 'Streak' link (data-testid='nav-streak') visible on library header (validated in iteration_15). Loading spinner unification: page-level spinners across LibraryPage/ReadingStreakPage/BookDetailPage/FavoritesPage/BookshelfPage/SettingsPage/AdminDashboard/PricingPage/LandingPage/AuthCallback/DocxReader all use unified `spinner-gap spinner-gap-lg|md|sm` — verified via grep. NOTE: inline button spinners (Loader2 w/ animate-spin) still exist in PricingPage, BookDetailPage, SettingsPage, AdminDashboard, PaymentSuccessPage — see minor issue. No console/network errors during flow.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/reading-streak/goal (line 1834-1870) correctly validates each optional param, upserts fields, and returns 400 when no field supplied — clean implementation.
server.py GET /api/reading-streak (line 1786-1832) computes pages_today/minutes_today from reading_sessions filtered by today's date — correct.

ReadingStreakPage.jsx uses single `savingGoal` state for all three goals; when Save is clicked, only the currently-edited card's Save button is visible in the DOM so this is fine, but conceptually a per-goal saving flag would be cleaner.

ReadingStreakDashboard.jsx compact mode (line 71-112) properly wraps the widget in <Link to='/reading-streak' data-testid='compact-streak-dashboard'> — meets the requirement. Non-compact mode is still in the same file; component is doing double-duty and could be split later.
ReadingStreakPage.jsx and ReadingStreakDashboard.jsx both call GET /api/reading-streak + /api/reading-stats in parallel — no duplicate serial roundtrips.
server.py Line 1858: minutes lower bound is 5. If user wants to allow 1-minute goals, tweak — currently frontend picker offers 10/15/20/30/45/60/90/120 which are all within 5-480, so safe.
